reviews.author: skip a.
reviews.text: Fantastic forest/beach access campground. Great restrooms with hot showers. It's our favorite camp spot!

reviews.author: Clayton's R.
reviews.text: So this was the first time we've camped here since they reopened the park after extensive repair work. And I must say so happy to be back. Upgraded utilities, repaved most areas, and trimmed some bad trees out. Feels great, love this park, definitely recommend staying!

reviews.author: Jimmie F.
reviews.text: Big parking lot! Easy access to beach. Trail could use improving. But great stop!

reviews.author: Elizabeth N.
reviews.text: Had an amazing time this summer for the weekend. The camp sites were as expected and more. The trees and plants were beyond my expectations.  Friendly neighbor’s, lots of kiddos, Clean and hot showers. My Kiddos had a great time exploring, we went to the cookout area and gazed at the stars at night. Our favorite beach is 10minutes away. We were right between Lincoln city and Newport, right off the freeway! So tons of restaurants and grocery store near by!

reviews.author: Carlie D.
reviews.text:
Love it here. For such a large campground a lot of the sites made you feel secluded. We came in week of spring break for a few days and then a few days after spring break and let me tell you that place was empty after school started again.
Restrooms and showers were very clean, sites clean, playground super clean. Beach access is near the A “loop if I’m not mistaken and is super easy to get to with restrooms right before the beach(helpful with kiddos).  The check in office is only open from 4-6 and you need to check in but if your checking in late and know it call them to let them know they’re all so kind. Will definitely be coming back knowing there’s a little walking trail by the creek that’s behind some of the sites.
